headline: Clear strategic roadmap, execution key to rerating

highlights: Bhalla, India CEO, outlined key strategic priorities to sustain momentum and achieve double-digit growth in FY27, while noting that a detailed update on 'Vision VIII' (FY29-31) will be shared in 6-8 months.

To reignite growth, management is focusing on four core areas: accelerating core growth, driving execution excellence in distribution, building a future-ready portfolio (targeting a 23% premium mix within 18 months and inorganic growth in adjacent categories), and doubling cost savings over the next 18 months through operating efficiencies.

While we are encouraged by management's clear focus, we prefer to wait for execution to take shape before turning more constructive on the stock. ▪ Vision VII (FY25-29) scorecard mixed; focus shifts to execution: Dabur’s mid-term review of the FY25–28 plan shows progress in premiumization and execution, though overall performance remains mixed.
The premium mix expanded from 17% to 20% in 18 months, distributor consolidation reduced the network by 43% (helping revive GT growth), and cost initiatives delivered INR 1.15bn in savings.
